audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected positive selector on all naturals to nonnegative principal square root; displayed function preserved.
Removed source prose variable n; g(x) formula and mathematical input meaning preserved.
Rephrased graph as relation contained in A times B.
Preserved function restriction formula and explicitly distinguished its domain-only operation from two-coordinate relation restriction.
Added nonempty-domain hypothesis to translated theorem and proof; exact general condition and counterexample recorded in adjacent edition note.
Added -3 as the value of f(7) and retained an adjacent keyed note.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The f(1) through f(7) table omits the final value -3.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் அட்டவணை f(7) இன் மதிப்பாக -3 ஐச் சேர்க்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The preceding formula fixes f(7) as -ceil(6/2)=-3.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired value row now correspond one-to-one with all seven headers?

audited_source_corrections.action: Retained the frozen source's triangular-number wording and formula; documented that 'sum of naturals below k' would be k(k-1)/2 under the edition's zero-based convention.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The source calls k(k+1)/2 the sum of natural numbers below k although this edition starts naturals at zero.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: மூலச் சொற்றொடரும் வாய்பாடும் உடலில் வைக்கப்பட்டு, குறியீட்டு முரண்பாடு பதிப்புக் குறிப்பில் வெளிப்படையாகப் பதிவு செய்யப்படுகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The displayed sequence and pairing formula use the standard zero-based triangular-number indexing; silently changing the formula would alter the construction.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Should a future corrected source revise the wording while preserving the displayed pairing formula?

audited_source_corrections.action: Clarified that the cofinite set is the complement in Nat of a finite subset of Nat.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The cofinite-set prose omits the relation between the finite set and Nat.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் அதனை இயல் எண்களின் கணத்திற்குள்ளான ஒரு முடிவுறு உட்கணத்தின் நிரப்பி எனத் தெளிவாக்குகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately following equivalence says Nat\A is finite.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the clarification agree exactly with the following equivalence?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the prose name of the second row-zero pair from (0,2) to (0,1), matching the adjacent array.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Pairing-alt prose gives the second pair as (0,2), contradicting its table and sequence.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் இரண்டாவது ஜோடியை (0,1) எனத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The adjacent pair positions are (0,0), (0,1), (0,2), and the table agrees.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does correcting the prose to (0,1) best preserve the stated construction?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the second repeated (2,m) family to (3,m), matching the completed array.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Pairing-alt repeats the family (2,m) while enumerating successive rows.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் இரண்டாவது வரிசையை (3,m) எனத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The following table contains rows (2,m), (3,m), and onward.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is (3,m) the unique correction consistent with the completed array?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the unbound output name s_k and s_k(n) by one bound sequence name s and s(n).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The reduction defines f(Z) as s_k although k is unbound.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் வெளியீட்டையும் அதன் உறுப்புகளையும் s, s(n) என்ற ஒரே கட்டுப்பட்ட பெயரால் குறிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The component condition uniquely determines the characteristic sequence of Z.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the single bound name s used consistently throughout the definition and surjectivity proof?

audited_source_corrections.action: Added an infinite tail of ones after the n initial zeros so every h(n) lies in Bin^omega.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The declared codomain contains infinite binary sequences, but the displayed h(n) is finite.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் n பூச்சியங்களுக்குப் பின் முடிவுறாமல் ஒன்றுகள் வரும் தொடரைப் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: முடிவுறு வெளியீட்டை அப்படியே வைத்தல்; சார்பின் இலக்கை மாற்றுதல்
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The intended counterexample needs a genuine map into Bin^omega.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the infinite-tail repair preserve non-surjectivity while making the codomain declaration true?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced both premature g(x)=y occurrences by f(x)=y.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The empty-set branch uses undefined g although the bijection in scope is f.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் இரண்டு இடங்களிலும் f(x)=y எனத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The proof has fixed f:A to B; g is introduced only later as an enumeration.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is replacing both occurrences by f(x)=y the complete repair?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the quantified domain from x in overline(A) to x in A.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: Cantor's proof changes the arbitrary element's domain from A to overline(A).
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் ஒவ்வொரு x∈A க்கும் எனத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: Both preceding cases concern an arbitrary x in A, and the conclusion must exclude every g(x).
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is x∈A the only domain that makes the surjectivity contradiction valid?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected s_n(m) to the mth digit of the nth string.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The prose reverses the string and digit indices relative to the following array.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் இதனை n ஆவது தொடரின் m ஆவது இலக்கம் எனத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The array places s_n(m) in row n and column m.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired prose now agree with every array entry and the later diagonal s_n(n)?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected the second repeated 1-to-0 instruction to 0-to-1.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The intuitive diagonal instruction repeats 1-to-0 instead of stating both complementary flips.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் இரண்டாவது மாற்றத்தை 0 இலிருந்து 1 ஆகத் திருத்துகிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The immediately following cases define both complementary flips.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the repaired instruction match both branches of the displayed definition?

audited_source_corrections.action: Replaced the unbound output name s_k and s_k(n) by one bound sequence name s and s(n).
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The alternate reduction again defines f(N) as s_k although k is unbound.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் உடல் வெளியீட்டையும் அதன் உறுப்புகளையும் s, s(n) என்ற ஒரே கட்டுப்பட்ட பெயரால் குறிக்கிறது.
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The component condition uniquely determines the characteristic sequence of N.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Is the single bound name s used consistently throughout the alternate reduction?

audited_source_corrections.action: Moved the alternate exercise's explicit label from the primary red namespace to the red-alt namespace.
audited_source_corrections.source_issue_or_choice: The primary and alternate reduction exercises carry the same full explicit label and become multiply defined in the source-complete reader.
audited_source_corrections.chosen_treatment: தமிழ் மாற்றுப் பயிற்சியின் அடையாளம் red-alt பெயரிடைவெளிக்கு மாற்றப்படுகிறது; முதன்மைப் பயிற்சியின் அடையாளம் மாறாது.
audited_source_corrections.alternatives_considered: இரட்டை அடையாளத்தை வைத்தல்; மாற்றுப் பயிற்சியின் அடையாளத்தை முழுவதும் நீக்குதல்
audited_source_corrections.rationale: The alternate unit's olfileid already establishes section id red-alt; changing only this explicit label yields a unique, predictable identifier without removing the anchor.
audited_source_corrections.precise_review_question: Does the corrected red-alt namespace preserve the intended anchor while eliminating the only duplicate full label?

audited_source_corrections.action: Corrected r-s to s-r in the prose inside the aligned definition, matching both the preceding equivalence and the displayed rational-order equation.
Attributed existence of a cut in S to the stated nonemptiness of S, rather than to the unrelated existence of an upper bound; the later use of the upper bound is preserved.
Corrected identification with equivalence relations to identification with equivalence classes, matching the immediately following construction.
Corrected 0_Rat to 0_Real in the positivity definition for a real equivalence class.
Clarified in the ordered-field theorem and exercise that the equivalence classes of Cauchy sequences, rather than raw sequences with ordinary equality, constitute the field.
Made explicit that f has the same ambient set A as domain and codomain before quantifying o in A, which is required by the closure proof and later application.
